title: Cubic character filter identity
statement: Let $\zeta=\exp(2\pi i/3)$, and let $\chi$ be the additive character of $\mathbb Z/3\mathbb Z$ determined by $\chi(1)=\zeta$. For every $a\in\mathbb Z/3\mathbb Z$, the indicator of $a=0$ satisfies $\mathbf 1_{\{0\}}(a)=\frac13+\frac23\operatorname{Re}(\chi(a))$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is an element of $\mathbb Z/3\mathbb Z$
